title: Fixture git inherits ambient GIT_CONFIG_* pins: the Go gate fails inside ticfac's own read-only review launch
description:
Under this review launch's GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY/VALUE pushInsteadOf pins, tests in cli (triage, run --cloud, cloud logs), reconcile, runstate, runsignal, exec/subprocess and exec/cloudflaresandbox fail pushing to their own temp bare origins; with GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0 all pass. A reviewer ticfac launches cannot run ticfac's gate; fixture git helpers should scrub GIT_CONFIG_* (and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL) from their environment.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding 652ad8d95ae0e28ccdbff56975ba1113dfe2b7647e4b74b5be68907605ed9832 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-xbp/attempt-32): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/652ad8d95ae0e28ccdbff56975ba1113dfe2b7647e4b74b5be68907605ed9832.json on the run branch.
